question: The former XS Usenet shutdown notice at https://xsusenet.com/ is no longer served (HTTP 522 on 2026-11-25 on every broker route and a direct probe; the nearest archived capture is also a 522). Can the EasyUsenet account migration described in debrid/xsusenet be confirmed from a first-party page?
why: The recorded shutdown and migration cannot be re-read from the first-party host; the record keeps the earlier verdict and marks the unreachable host as unverified.
